x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

OnboardingTraject.title: OnboardingTraject
OnboardingTraject.description: A guided member onboarding traject (raadswisseling/installatie and its board/association analogues): a schema:Action whose agent is the griffie and whose object is the incoming member's Person. Carries a structured checklist (steps), a declarative lifecycle (ADR-031), declarative step reminders (ADR-031), and the beëdiging outcome as data. Everything the traject references (Membership, Fractie/FractieLidmaatschap, nevenfuncties, meetings) is owned elsewhere and linked by UUID: this schema creates none of them (design D1/D5/D6). DECLARATIVE CORE ONLY: NC group provisioning (groepen-toewijzen), Files induction-pack delivery (introductiepakket), and the raadswisseling Member-Import diff are imperative side-effects DEFERRED to OnboardingProvisioningService/InductionPackService/RaadswisselingService; this schema models only the traject, its steps, and their status. The manifest and all widget/filter sources reference this schema by its slug 'onboarding-traject'.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-MOB-003). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). gestart → in-uitvoering → afgerond | vervallen; afgerond and vervallen terminal. COMPLETION GUARD (REQ-MOB-003): a traject must NOT reach 'afgerond' while any non-optional (verplicht:true) step is not 'afgerond'. Whether the lifecycle dialect can express this as a property predicate over the steps array is an open question (design Open Questions); the spec permits a documented server-side validation on the transition action as the fallback — never a silent pass. No app-side state machine.

onboardingTrajectCreated._note: Created notification to the griffie group (REQ-MOB-010). The dialect has no recipient kind that targets the {{person}}'s account directly; object-acl(read) + the griffie/decidesk-members groups is the closest declarative approximation — verify against OR's notification rule engine at import; never an imperative dispatch (notification-dialect gate).

onboardingStepDueSoon._note: Due-soon step rappel (REQ-MOB-010). intervalSec 86400 (daily) is PROVISIONAL. Filter targets non-terminal lifecycle only. The 'a step's dueDate is approaching' vs 'a step is past its dueDate' distinction lives inside the steps array; the simple filter shape cannot express a per-step dueDate comparison — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets this and onboardingStepOverdue as due-soon/overdue window semantics at live import (same caveat as the toezegging rappels).

onboardingStepOverdue._note: Overdue step rappel (REQ-MOB-010). intervalSec 86400 (daily) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal lifecycle so nothing fires for afgerond/vervallen. Same per-step-dueDate window caveat as onboardingStepDueSoon.

person.title: Person
person.description: Reference to the incoming member's Person (schema:Action object). Required.

targetBody.title: Target body
targetBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody the member is being onboarded into. Required. With targetRole it derives the body-role→group mapping used by the (deferred, imperative) groepen-toewijzen provisioning.

targetRole.title: Target role
targetRole.description: The role the member takes up (matches the Membership role enum, person-and-membership). Required.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: What triggered the onboarding. nieuw-lid = an individual new member; raadswisseling-batch = created by a raadswisseling run (shares a batch label); tussentijdse-opvolging = an interim successor. Required.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The structured onboarding checklist. Required. Each step carries its own status; step updates SHALL write the full array carried forward from the freshly read object (OpenRegister saveObject is PUT-semantic), and updating one step SHALL NOT alter any other step. CONSTRAINT: a step's status may be 'overgeslagen' ONLY when verplicht is false, enforced at save time (no if/then dialect), documented here. The imperative work behind account-koppeling/groepen-toewijzen/introductiepakket is deferred (design D3/D6); this array models the checklist and status only.

stepType.title: Step type
stepType.description: Kind of onboarding step. beediging = record the oath; account-koppeling = link the Nextcloud account; groepen-toewijzen = provision body-role groups (imperative, deferred); introductiepakket = deliver the induction pack (imperative, deferred); nevenfuncties-intake = collect ancillary positions (interests-and-integrity, reference-only); fractie-toewijzing = assign the fractie (fractievoorzitter, reference-only); custom = a griffie-defined step.

status.title: Status
status.description: Per-step status. 'overgeslagen' is only valid when verplicht is false (enforced at save time).

mandatory.title: Mandatory
mandatory.description: Whether the step is mandatory. A mandatory step blocks the traject from reaching 'afgerond' until it is 'afgerond' and can never be 'overgeslagen'.

dueDate.title: Due date
dueDate.description: Optional date the step is due. Drives the declarative due-soon and overdue step reminders and the overdue-steps dashboard KPI.

completedAt.title: Completed at
completedAt.description: Set when the step is completed.

completedBy.title: Completed by
completedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the person who completed the step.

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional free-text note on the step (e.g. a skip reason or a provisioning result).

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Optional URL or object UUID linking the step's subject (e.g. the beëdigingsVergadering, the delivered introductiepakket folder, or the created FractieLidmaatschap once the sibling capability performs it).

swearingInDate.title: Oath date
swearingInDate.description: Date the member was sworn in. Completing the beediging step requires beëdigingsDatum, beëdigingsType and beëdigingsVergadering. Field name aligned with the fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling vocabulary so that change reads it as the FractieLidmaatschap begin-datum without mapping (design D5). Optional until the oath is recorded.

beëdigingsType.title: Oath type
beëdigingsType.description: Whether the member swore an oath (eed) or made an affirmation (belofte). Required to complete the beediging step.

swearingInMeeting.title: Oath meeting
swearingInMeeting.description: Reference to the Meeting (installatievergadering/raadsvergadering) where the member was sworn in. The ceremony itself stays with the meetings capabilities; this only records the outcome. Optional until the oath is recorded.

ncAccount.title: Nextcloud account
ncAccount.description: Nextcloud user id linked to the member by the account-koppeling step. Optional until linked; the introductiepakket step depends on it.

membership.title: Membership
membership.description: Reference to the Membership created as an outcome of the traject (person-and-membership). Optional until created: a raadswisseling onboards a person before the Membership exists (design D1).

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: Free-form batch label linking trajecten created by one raadswisseling run. Optional; drives the batch filter and progress tracking.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Traject status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): gestart → in-uitvoering → afgerond | vervallen. afgerond and vervallen are terminal. A traject cannot reach afgerond while a mandatory step is not afgerond.

OffboardingTraject.title: OffboardingTraject
OffboardingTraject.description: A guided member offboarding traject (raadswisseling departure or an individual leave): a schema:Action recording the departure of a member from a governance body as data, the membership to end-date, the exit reason, a structured checklist (steps), a declarative lifecycle (ADR-031) and declarative step reminders. The offboarding checklist always includes end-dating the Membership (person-and-membership endDate), revoking Nextcloud groups and OR RBAC scopes (fail-closed, always mandatory: ), a personal-data note that references the document-annotations author export (GDPR, no bespoke export here), and the exit confirmation. DECLARATIVE CORE ONLY: the group revocation and membership end-dating are imperative side-effects DEFERRED to OnboardingProvisioningService/RaadswisselingService; this schema models the traject, its steps and their status. The manifest and all widget/filter sources reference this schema by its slug 'offboarding-traject'.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-MOB-003). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial'). gestart → in-uitvoering → afgerond | vervallen; afgerond and vervallen terminal. COMPLETION GUARD (REQ-MOB-003/008): a traject must NOT reach 'afgerond' while any verplicht step is not 'afgerond'; the groepen-intrekken revocation step is ALWAYS verplicht, so offboarding cannot complete without verified revocation. Expressibility in the lifecycle dialect is an open question; documented server-side transition validation is the permitted fallback, never a silent pass. No app-side state machine.

offboardingTrajectCreated._note: Created notification to the griffie group (REQ-MOB-010). object-acl(read) + griffie/decidesk-members is the closest declarative approximation to 'the griffie group'; never an imperative dispatch (notification-dialect gate).

offboardingStepDueSoon._note: Due-soon step rappel (REQ-MOB-010). intervalSec 86400 (daily) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal lifecycle. Per-step dueDate window semantics: verify against OR's scheduled-notification engine at live import (same caveat as the onboarding rappels).

offboardingStepOverdue._note: Overdue step rappel (REQ-MOB-010). intervalSec 86400 (daily) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal lifecycle. Same per-step-dueDate window caveat as offboardingStepDueSoon.

person.title: Person
person.description: Reference to the departing member's Person (schema:Action object). Required.

body.title: Body
body.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody the member is leaving. Required. With the member's role it derives the body-role→group mapping used by the (deferred, imperative) groepen-intrekken revocation.

membership.title: Membership
membership.description: Reference to the Membership to be end-dated (person-and-membership). Required. The offboarding traject must survive this membership's end-dating (design D1); end-dating happens on the lidmaatschap-beeindigen step, never as an automatic side effect.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: What triggered the offboarding. individueel = an individual departure; raadswisseling-batch = created by a raadswisseling run (shares a batch label). Required.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Date the membership ends. The lidmaatschap-beeindigen step sets Membership.endDate = eindeDatum (person-and-membership). Required.

endReason.title: End reason
endReason.description: Reason the membership ends, aligned with the fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling vocabulary. Required.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The structured offboarding checklist. Required. Includes at minimum lidmaatschap-beeindigen, groepen-intrekken (always verplicht: ), persoonsgegevens-notitie (references the document-annotations author export, no bespoke export), and exit-bevestiging. Each step carries its own status; step updates SHALL write the full array carried forward from the freshly read object (saveObject is PUT-semantic), and updating one step SHALL NOT alter any other step. CONSTRAINT: status 'overgeslagen' only when verplicht is false, enforced at save time. The imperative revocation/end-dating behind these steps is deferred (design D3); this array models the checklist and status only.

stepType.title: Step type
stepType.description: Kind of offboarding step. lidmaatschap-beeindigen = end-date the Membership (imperative, deferred); groepen-intrekken = revoke body-role groups + RBAC scopes (imperative, deferred, always mandatory: ); persoonsgegevens-notitie = GDPR note referencing the document-annotations author export (reference-only); exit-bevestiging = griffie exit confirmation; custom = a griffie-defined step.

status.title: Status
status.description: Per-step status. 'overgeslagen' is only valid when verplicht is false (enforced at save time). The groepen-intrekken step is always verplicht and can never be skipped.

mandatory.title: Mandatory
mandatory.description: Whether the step is mandatory. A mandatory step blocks the traject from reaching 'afgerond' until it is 'afgerond'; groepen-intrekken is always verplicht.

dueDate.title: Due date
dueDate.description: Optional date the step is due. Drives the declarative due-soon and overdue step reminders and the overdue-steps dashboard KPI.

completedAt.title: Completed at
completedAt.description: Set when the step is completed.

completedBy.title: Completed by
completedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the person who completed the step.

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional free-text note (e.g. the verified post-revocation group list, or a skip reason).

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Optional URL or object UUID linking the step's subject (e.g. the document-annotations export for the persoonsgegevens-notitie step).

exitConfirmedBy.title: Exit confirmed by
exitConfirmedBy.description: Nextcloud UID of the griffie member who confirmed the exit. Optional until confirmed.

exitConfirmedOn.title: Exit confirmed at
exitConfirmedOn.description: When the exit was confirmed by the griffie. Optional until confirmed.

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: Free-form batch label linking trajecten created by one raadswisseling run. Optional; drives the batch filter and progress tracking.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Traject status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): gestart → in-uitvoering → afgerond | vervallen. afgerond and vervallen are terminal. Cannot reach afgerond while the always-mandatory groepen-intrekken step is not afgerond.
